description: Counterexample traces and invariant violation fixtures for ElasticSlots transcript protocol

counterexamples.name: out_of_order_retirement
counterexamples.description: Retiring a block out of sequence violates FIFO commit order and corrupts logical history

expected_rejection.reason: block b2 cannot retire before head block b1 commits

counterexamples.name: mutable_speculative_leakage
counterexamples.description: Active mutable block streaming interim snapshot into logical history before finalization

expected_rejection.reason: mutable blocks emit zero rows to logical history while running

counterexamples.name: append_only_non_monotonic_mutation
counterexamples.description: Append-only block updating snapshot with modified prefix or shrinking content

expected_rejection.reason: append-only snapshots must be prefix-monotone extensions of prior snapshots

counterexamples.name: duplicate_native_rows_on_retire_after_streaming
counterexamples.description: Retiring a partially streamed block by re-emitting full snapshot duplicates rows in scrollback

invalid_action.flaw: appending full snapshot ['row 1', 'row 2'] to scrollback produces duplicate 'row 1'

counterexamples.name: rebuild_resize_without_epoch_increment
counterexamples.description: Rebuild resize failing to increment display epoch allows stale native row collisions

invalid_action.flaw: viewport rendered at 120 cols without incrementing epoch from 1

counterexamples.name: blind_retry_after_partial_write_failure
counterexamples.description: Retrying full write batch after partial terminal I/O failure duplicates already accepted rows

invalid_action.flaw: re-sending row 1 duplicates row 1 on physical terminal
